# AgentSiam

> Short-term rental management in Chiang Mai, Thailand. Feasibility, vacation rental permission and management for short-term rentals, chosen against the property rather than sold as a package. For guests, AgentSiam runs one house itself and finds privately owned homes for monthly stays, from owners and never from other agents.

AgentSiam Co., Ltd., 42 Soi 1, Wiang Ping Road, Chang Khlan, Chiang Mai 50100, Thailand. Email hi@agentsiam.com, phone +66 98 482 5832. The site is in English, Thai (/th) and Simplified Chinese (/zh).

## For property owners

- [How it works](https://www.agentsiam.com/how-it-works): six services, chosen against your property rather than sold as a package. Feasibility, the non-hotel exemption filing, and OTA and direct booking management. Houses, townhouses and small buildings in Chiang Mai; condos too, where the building permits short stays in writing.
- [Short-term rental licence in Chiang Mai](https://www.agentsiam.com/short-term-rental-licence-chiang-mai): the 30-night rule, the non-hotel route (Certificate of Exemption) for houses, townhouses and villas, and why condos cannot use it. A summary of published sources, not legal advice.
- [Short-term rental management in Phuket](https://www.agentsiam.com/management/phuket)
- [Short-term rental management in Bangkok](https://www.agentsiam.com/management/bangkok)
- [Contact](https://www.agentsiam.com/contact): tell us about your property. We read it and reply within two working days.

## For guests

- [Houses for rent in Chiang Mai, by the month](https://www.agentsiam.com/house-for-rent-chiang-mai): send your dates, size, area, budget and must-haves. We find a privately owned home that fits and send it with the total price. Every home is checked first: photos, exact location and a Wi-Fi speed test from the owner. Any deposit is agreed per home and stated before you book.
- [Lotus House](https://www.agentsiam.com/lotushouse): the house AgentSiam runs. A three-storey townhouse with a rooftop terrace in Chang Khlan, Chiang Mai, near the Night Bazaar. Two king bedrooms, two bathrooms, a full kitchen and space for four guests. Book direct on this site.
- [Lotus House local guide](https://www.agentsiam.com/lotushouse/local-guide)
- [All properties](https://www.agentsiam.com/properties)
